verdict.rationale: Jules documents plan-tier usage limits (e.g., daily task counts and concurrency numbers like 300/60) on a dedicated usage-limits page, and community reports confirm daily task caps exist and change between plan tiers (60→15 on free). However, there's no evidence of an engineering-lead-facing dashboard or admin console to actively view/manage team members' limits or concurrency in real time — only a static docs page describing tier limits. Missing for 10: team/org-level visibility into individual usage, ability to adjust or allocate limits across a team, and any admin/lead-specific management UI.
